s1.desc: a dining room drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a cream table in front of him, a brown armchair behind him, a round wall clock and framed pictures of a starfish and a whale

beats.text: Pax sits at the table holding a bag of chips and tears it open
Pax peeks into the full bag and smiles with his eyes closed
Pax tips the bag over a lilac bowl and pours out a thick stream of chips
Pax keeps shaking the bag as the chips pile high and spill over the rim onto the table
Pax sets the bag down beside the overflowing bowl and looks ahead with a pleased face

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the wall band (y 0.20-0.38, pictures and clock) scale 1.000-1.001, <1 px, cc 0.998 every 8th frame; compare 0/94 keeps the picture frames, clock and table edge black. Only the clock hands step (in-world). The bag's label is an invented snack name with a crab mascot (in-world text, not a real brand logo; never transcribed). Pax's beak is the amber-orange variant also kept in PP-BFPockets. No overlay in the top third or bottom fifth

spans.view: with a cream table in front of him, a brown armchair behind him, two framed landscape pictures and a potted plant

beats.text: Pax sits at the table holding a bag of chips, tears it open and peers inside
Pax smiles with his eyes closed and lifts the bag up
Pax tips the bag over the lilac bowl and pours out a small handful of chips
Pax squints and shakes the bag hard over the bowl
Pax sets the bag down and scratches the back of his head, frowning at the half-empty bowl

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the wall band (y 0.20-0.38) scale 1.0000, 0.1 px, cc 1.000 every 8th frame; raw difference on the picture band 0.00-0.10 vs f95; compare 95/188 keeps the pictures, plant and table edge black. Same snack bag as f0-94. No overlay

spans.view: with a cream table in front of him, a brown armchair behind him, a framed sailboat picture and an orange lamp on a side table

beats.text: Pax sits at the table holding a bag of chips and tugs at its top
Pax squeezes one eye shut and strains to pull the bag open
Pax peeks into the open bag with a puzzled look
Pax holds the bag upside down over the empty lilac bowl and shakes it
Pax keeps shaking the bag as a single chip tumbles out and drops into the bowl
Pax sets the bag down on the table and reaches into the bowl with a frown
Pax lifts the single chip up in his flipper and stares at it
Pax watches the chip crumble into falling crumbs, his beak dropping open

spans.notes: camera locked: raw pixel difference on the picture and lamp region (x 0.6-1.0, y 0.2-0.42) 0.00 vs f189 every 6th frame through f333; compare 189/337 keeps the picture, lamp and table edge black (ECC on the full-width wall band reads cc 0.86-0.96 only because Pax's head enters it). No overlay
